Status Detail.value: June 2026: Owensboro Municipal Utilities told the Owensboro Board of Commissioners that Green River East GenCo LLC has applied to connect a 545 MW gas plant at the former Elmer Smith site. The utility approved an option to lease about 30 acres, and a six-month interconnection study is under way. The utility said the project is early and not guaranteed.
Status Detail.note:
The Owensboro Times article from June 17, 2026 at https://www.owensborotimes.com/news/2026/06/omu-exploring-545-megawatt-natural-gas-power-plant-at-former-elmer-smith-site/ and the Messenger-Inquirer article at https://www.messenger-inquirer.com/news/local/firm-eyeing-omu-property-for-gas-fired-power-plant-utility-plans-rate-increase-in-september/article_a47db0d7-6d69-5c2f-9ff2-831056cba7ce.html both describe the option to lease and the early days of the project. The existing text about the 2027 move to MISO is kept below this entry.

Date of the announced step:
- Open https://www.owensborotimes.com/news/2026/06/omu-exploring-545-megawatt-natural-gas-power-plant-at-former-elmer-smith-site/ and read the first paragraphs. The article is dated June 17, 2026 and says the general manager updated the board 'on Tuesday', which is June 16, 2026.
- The article says the commission 'previously approved an option-to-lease agreement', but gives no date for that vote, so no earlier date could be set.

milestones.note: The Owensboro Times of June 17, 2026 reports that the utility's general manager updated the Owensboro Board of Commissioners on Tuesday, June 16, 2026, on the proposed 545 MW plant. This is the first public report found.

units.notes: The status stays announced. I found no start year, turbine make, turbine model or technology in any article, permit record or queue file. Reports run through August 2026 and the project is moving, so Latest Activity is left alone. Operator, combined heat and power, and backup power are not stated anywhere I could read.

Owner(s).note: The Messenger-Inquirer article at https://www.messenger-inquirer.com/news/local/firm-eyeing-omu-property-for-gas-fired-power-plant-utility-plans-rate-increase-in-september/article_a47db0d7-6d69-5c2f-9ff2-831056cba7ce.html says Green River East GenCo LLC holds a five-year option on part of the Elmer Smith property. No parent company is named in any article I found.

qa.question: When did Unit 1 reach the announced step?
qa.finding: The first report I found is The Owensboro Times article of June 17, 2026. It says Green River East GenCo LLC has applied to connect a 545 MW plant and that the utility had earlier approved an option to lease.
qa.recommendation: Date the announced step June 2026. The option-to-lease vote has no published date, so June 2026 is the earliest date found; it is proposed as a Status Detail edit with a dated milestone.
qa.note: I searched the Midcontinent Independent System Operator queue file at https://www.misoenergy.org/api/giqueue/getprojects. It has no row for Elmer Smith or Green River East, which fits the article saying the interconnection study is run by Owensboro Municipal Utilities and not yet by the grid operator. The Daviess County Fiscal Court minutes of August 13, 2026 at https://www.daviessky.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/OB-43-08-13-2026-Minutes.pdf mention the proposed 545 MW plant in public comment but give no date for the announcement. I could not find the date of the option-to-lease vote or a Kentucky Secretary of State record. Third pass: the date is now also proposed as a milestone on the Status Detail finding.

qa.question: What technology will the Elmer Smith plant use?
qa.finding: No article, permit or queue row found names a turbine type, model or maker. No air permit application exists in the state eSearch record, which only holds the old coal plant permits.
qa.recommendation: Leave technology as unknown until an air permit application or interconnection record names it.
qa.note: The Kentucky eSearch air permit record at https://dep.gateway.ky.gov/eSearch/ holds only the old coal plant permits. The Midcontinent queue file has no row for this project. No turbine maker or type is named in the June 2026 articles or the August 2026 county minutes.

qa.question: Should the Elmer Smith point stay exact?
qa.finding: The permit address and a satellite look both put GEM's point on the former Elmer Smith plant pad. The leased 30 acre parcel is not published.
qa.recommendation: Leave the point and accuracy as they are.
qa.note: I did not run a satellite look. No document gives coordinates, and the Owensboro Times article at https://www.owensborotimes.com/news/2026/06/omu-exploring-545-megawatt-natural-gas-power-plant-at-former-elmer-smith-site/ names only the former plant site and about 30 acres.

qa.question: Is Backup Power no correct for Unit 1?
qa.finding: The articles describe a plant for the grid and say nothing about backup service.
qa.recommendation: Leave it as no. No document states it either way.
qa.note: No air permit application, queue row or county record names backup generators for this project. The Daviess County Fiscal Court minutes at https://www.daviessky.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/OB-43-08-13-2026-Minutes.pdf do not mention them.
